test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As of January 2023, who among the following is the Chairman of Khadi & Village Industries Commission (KVIC) of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manoj Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of January 2023, **Manoj Kumar** is the **Chairman of the Khadi & Village Industries Commission (KVIC) of India.**
 
• Manoj Kumar, formerly an expert member of marketing at the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), has been appointed as the Chairman of this statutory body by the Government of India.
 
• This promotion comes as Vinai Kumar Saxena, the former Chairman of KVIC, assumes the position of Lieutenant Governor of Delhi.
 
• With a background in marketing and rural development, Manoj Kumar previously served as an Expert Member (Marketing) at KVIC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC)** was established in April 1957 by the Government of India through the enactment of the 'Khadi and Village Industries Commission Act of 1956'.
 
• Operating as an apex organization under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, KVIC is responsible for overseeing khadi and village industries across India.
 
• Its primary objective is to plan, promote, facilitate, organize, and assist in the establishment and development of these industries in rural areas, coordinating with other relevant agencies in rural development efforts as needed.
 
• Initially, in April 1957, KVIC assumed the responsibilities of the former All India Khadi and Village Industries Board.
 
• While its headquarters are located in Mumbai, KVIC also operates six zonal offices situated in Delhi, Bhopal, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Mumbai, and Guwahati. Additionally, it maintains offices in 28 states to effectively implement its various programs and initiatives.
